comments.author: Jafar

comments.author: Jafar
comments.body: quite useful, force opponent to distraction when extinguishing the fire after melee. 2 seconds distraction in battle is enough to result yourself a critical.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: How much damage do they do per use? And what's the recommended way, use one and bell out of melee, or stay in melee if you can and spam them?

comments.author: Yaknow
comments.body: the damage isn't that great, 50-100. I don't know about 'best' use, but sometimes a player who has a very badly damaged ship will melee to keep you from firing on them anymore. You have to gauge how many rounds you think you can survive vs how much dura your opponent has left. If you think the firebombs can finish them off then stay in, otherwise I would play it safe and bell out.

comments.author: Battousai
comments.body: The damage is 10% of the ship durability

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: Thanks guys, well I was thinking whether firebombs could work against those ghost ships roaming the seas now as part of the egg hunt event, and are immune to melee. They can't, they only seem to cause 10 damage or less and not start a fire. But these ghost ships are quite special in many respects anyway. I sank a ghost admiral with cannons, eventually.

comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
10% ship durability damage per use/per opponent no matter what ship or ship skills equipped. Especially useful for high ranking pvp and/or Ganador boss but pricey to deploy at 800k per with title

Can also plunder from sinop fleet in Black Sea
